visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: LRU Cache with OrderedDict
visualizerParams.description: An OrderedDict remembers insertion order. Move a key to the end whenever it is used, and drop the first item when the cache is over capacity.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
from collections import OrderedDict


class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.items = OrderedDict()

    def get(self, key):
        if key not in self.items:
            return -1
        self.items.move_to_end(key)
        return self.items[key]

    def put(self, key, value):
        self.items[key] = value
        self.items.move_to_end(key)
        if len(self.items) > self.capacity:
            self.items.popitem(last=False)


cache = LRUCache(2)
cache.put("a", 1)
cache.put("b", 2)
cache.get("a")
cache.put("c", 3)
print(list(cache.items))
